newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Afghan Taleban enter north opposition stronghold.
newsitem.headline: Afghan Taleban enter north opposition stronghold.

text.p: The Taleban Islamic militia entered the main opposition-held northern Afghan town of Mazar-i-Sharif on Saturday, witnesses said.

They said groups of Taleban fighters, on tanks and jeeps, rode into the town, the stronghold of the opposition leader General Abdul Rashid Dostum, at 5:00 p.m. (1230 gmt) amid a burst of celebratory gunfire.

The Taleban fighters, waving white flags, entered Mazar-i-Sharif, capital of Balkh province, hours after Taleban sources reported the fall of Dostum's military headquarters town of Shibarghan, capital of Jozjan province, to his opponents.
Earlier, panic swept Mazar-i-Sharif after reports of the fall of Shibarghan, 130 km (80 miles) in the west.
There was no immediate confirmation of the fall of Shibarghan and no word on Dostum's whereabouts.
